description: Auto-nudges the model to file EPLUS tool failures via this plugin's report_issue tool. One PostToolUseFailure wiring running report-tool-failure.ps1. The fleet is Windows-only and Cowork executes hooks on the Windows host under PowerShell (never inside the Linux sandbox, even when the VM is running), so the hook is a single PowerShell invocation; the earlier POSIX .sh half was removed because it had no execution path on any seat and its failed lookup polluted every export's hook stderr. Context-only (additionalContext); never blocks a tool call; always exits 0. Disable per-machine with EPLUS_NO_ERROR_NUDGE=1.
